changes.title: Leash arc
items: Leashes bow higher: a strained leash's thread arcs twice as high as before (a pause-page slider sets it)

changes.title: Volume
items: The pause page has Music and Sound effects volume sliders at its top, remembered on this browser

changes.title: Bedroom pause
items: Esc (or the pad's Start) pauses in the bedroom too, with the test sliders, Copy values and Report; Esc no longer leaves a mid-night visit to the room (its Back to the island button does)
